levels.surface: أبو عبد الرحمن محمد بن أحمد بن الحسين العسكري

notes: «حدثني ... جميعا عن» : the two first co-transmitters share one level
«أبيه علي بن مهزيار»: the father is named by relation plus name, so the link is the name alone
«قال قال الصادق (ع)» after the chain: the Imam is the last link (imam_in_text)
The THQ English sanad names other transmitters: recorded as a fix, the reading follows the Arabic

fixes.reason: THQ's English sanad runs through Safwan ibn Yahya and Abil Sabbah; the Arabic names Ibn Mahziyar, Ibn Abi Umayr and Abu Hamza al-Thumali

evidence.quote: from Abil Sabbāḥ – or from Abil Sabbāḥ from Abī Basīr
